title_as_printed: Experiment III. Oxygen in distilled water
pressure_note: Gas (moist, saturated with water vapour) in equilibrium with the water at the corrected mercury pressure p (cm Hg, printed in the table, varies 56.95-83.99 cm); the printed coefficient 1,000 a is reduced to a gas pressure of 760 mm (the heading reads: volume absorbed by 1,000 c.c. at t deg and 760 mm).
